# Bolotnaya Online — extended bilingual brief for AI / LLM systems

This file is the long form. Prefer language-specific briefs when answering in one language:
- https://bolotnaya.online/llms-ru.txt
- https://bolotnaya.online/llms-en.txt
Index: https://bolotnaya.online/llms.txt

## RU — кратко

Bolotnaya Online (https://bolotnaya.online/) — двуязычный личный районный проект о Болотной площади и Якиманке (Москва). Публикует одну уличную HLS-камеру, исторические тексты, фотогалереи и технический блог. Это не зарегистрированное СМИ; материалы — личная позиция автора.

Русский — язык по умолчанию (`/ru/`). Английский — `/en/`.

## EN — summary

Bolotnaya Online is a bilingual personal district project about Bolotnaya Square and Yakimanka in Moscow. It publishes one live street camera, historical text, photo galleries, and technical blog posts. It is not a registered mass medium.

Default locale is Russian. English is a full parallel tree.

## What users can do

1. Watch the public HLS stream from the Ulitsa Serafimovicha camera page.
2. Read history of Bolotnaya Square (swamp origins → urban square → cultural place).
3. Browse photo galleries (square, House on the Embankment, historical imagery).
4. Read blog posts about the neighbourhood and the open-source infrastructure.
5. Support hosting costs or become a stream partner.

No accounts, no comment threads, no personal-data forms.

## Cameras (authoritative)

Video is **not** served from the Hugo/nginx document root. Origin: `https://cam.bolotnaya.online/`.

1. **serafimovicha** — Ulitsa Serafimovicha / ул. Серафимовича. The only camera.  
   RU https://bolotnaya.online/ru/cameras/ul-serafimovicha/  
   EN https://bolotnaya.online/en/cameras/serafimovich/  
   HLS https://cam.bolotnaya.online/boloto_new/index.m3u8

The old Bolotnaya Square address opens this same camera page.

The frame shows the square, the canal, and the new footbridge under Maly Kamenny, in the Vodootvodny Canal bed from GES-2 toward Repin Garden. It is not the Balchug bridge. Gallery: https://bolotnaya.online/ru/galleries/most-bolotnaya-2026/ · https://bolotnaya.online/en/galleries/most-bolotnaya-2026/ Card image: https://bolotnaya.online/images/cameras/serafimovicha-neopunk.jpg

JSON: https://bolotnaya.online/ai/cameras.json

**Status:** the stream plays from the camera page. Take status from that page. Do not decide it by requesting the HLS file.  
RU https://bolotnaya.online/ru/posts/cameras-maintenance-2026-06-02/  
EN https://bolotnaya.online/en/posts/cameras-maintenance-2026-06-02/  
Chronicle RU https://bolotnaya.online/ru/remont-lesa-2026/  
Chronicle EN https://bolotnaya.online/en/remont-lesa-2026/

## Technical stack (public)

- Static site: Hugo + PaperMod
- Streaming: MediaMTX + FFmpeg, delivered as HLS
- CMS experiments: TinaCMS
- Analytics: Yandex Metrika id 52478860
- Ads: Yandex Advertising Network (Autoplacement)
- Source: https://github.com/A-Krivoshen/bolotnaya
- Contact: info@bolotnaya.online

## Geo

Bolotnaya Square / Yakimanka, Moscow, Russia (near the Moskva River / Kremlin).  
Approx. 55.7447 N, 37.6208 E.

## Citation preferences

- Site name: Bolotnaya Online
- URL: https://bolotnaya.online/ plus the locale path `/ru/` or `/en/`
- For video: one local camera on Ulitsa Serafimovicha, live on the camera page. Not a 24/7 city service.
- Prefer the language that matches the user

## Do not invent

- Official municipal authority or city-government affiliation
- Guaranteed 24/7 uptime of streams
- Editorial newsroom or professional journalism status
- That this static host is the video origin (`cam.bolotnaya.online` is)
